summary: The filing reports routine board leadership changes: Steven A. Michaels was elected Chairman while remaining CEO, and Ray M. Robinson became Lead Independent Director. A one-time $5M RSU grant vesting over years 3–5 was awarded to Michaels for retention. The annual meeting results are also disclosed. No special-situation event (merger, tender, restructuring, activist campaign, etc.) occurred. The board changes are not forced/abrupt departures—they reflect a normal succession and compensatory arrangement.
